rules.surface: low when more than 20% of sampled vertices lie further than 6 mm from any BP3D bone or muscle surface
rules.canal: low when more than 20% of sampled vertices lie inside bone (the vertebral canal wall); clearance from the wall is recorded, not judged
rules.envelope: low when more than 20% of sampled vertices lie outside the body envelope (BP3D's skin) or inside bone; no surface-distance test
